title: A Conformally Invariant Dirac-type Equation on Compact Spin Manifolds: the Effect of the Geometry
summary: Given a closed Riemannian Spin manifold $(M,g)$ of dimension greater or equal than four, we consider a generalized conformally invariant equation involving the Dirac operator with a non-linearity of convolution type. We show that the Aubib-type inequality corresponding to the problem is always strict, unless $(M,g)$ is conformal to the round sphere. In particular, this result provides an existence result for a ground state to the conformal Dirac-Einstein problem in dimension four.
